fork_sha.note: Source baseline observed and pinned per CHE-537 delivery plan. Weekly upstream review and manual pin promotion after qualification -- see FORK_MAINTENANCE.md. This value must be updated (new revision) if the pinned SHA changes; execution stages must re-read it at admission rather than caching an older value.

gate1_manifest_mechanism.status: OPEN (draft, not merged) as observed at CHE-537 authoring time
gate1_manifest_mechanism.note: Reused by reference, not rebuilt or ported here. Per-attempt LLM identity manifests (artemis/config/attempt_manifest.py) and reconciliation (artemis/config/attempt_reconciliation.py) are produced at real-run time by this mechanism once it is merged onto the pinned fork_sha (or its own base is advanced past fork_sha, whichever the executing stage's admitted revision resolves to). This qualification manifest does not claim Gate 1 has passed.

candidate_app.note: Not pinned by this issue. CHE-537 is scoped to authoring the qualification input contract only -- no device operations, no APK install, no provider calls. The execution stage (CHE-540+) fills these fields for the exact candidate build under test and must not proceed without them; a null value here is a hold, not a default.

dependency_lock.note: Populate via `sha256sum uv.lock` at the exact fork_sha checkout used for the qualification run. Left null here since this issue performs no install.

accessibility_helper.name: Artemis Accessibility Helper (UIAutomator2 fallback)
accessibility_helper.note: Per-host on-device helper referenced in CHE-388's install surface. Digest recorded by the host install stage, not authored here.

model_targets.role: baseline tier under CHE-388's 'at least two model tiers' requirement
second tier; matches config/artemis.jsonc's current top-level default node

tier_vocabulary_source: artemis/config/attempt_manifest.py TIER_MODELS (PR #1 / CHE-491) -- do not diverge from that mapping; if it changes, this manifest must be revised to match rather than declaring a third mapping.
profile_note: Pro selected over Flash for this journey: the assertion step (read back a persisted value against an expected/negative token) needs the Checker's verified-checkpoint path (CHE-388 install-surface note: Flash has no final report and no verification). verification_level left to the execution stage's per-run config, not pinned here.

entry_point.note: CHE-537 plan: 'Prefer the existing MCP route with foreground terminal collection; select native CLI/SDK only where exact installed behavior proves necessary.' mobile_run_task params referenced: task_desc, model (tier profile), locked_app_package, app_path, expected_output_desc, verification_level.

fixture.reset_procedure: adb shell am force-stop <package> && adb shell pm clear <package>, cold-start verified before every attempt
fixture.note: N=10 positive runs per target/tier plus one separate negative control per CHE-388 plan v2. Counts are per (tier, profile) combination in model_targets, not a single global N=10.

revision_policy.rule: A changed candidate revision (app_sha, apk_digest_sha256) or a changed fork_sha forces a new manifest revision and invalidates all evidence collected against the prior revision. Evidence is not transferable across revisions.
revision_policy.source: CHE-388 review contract invariant: 'a changed candidate revision forces fresh step-2 review AND invalidates prior evidence (new run required)'.

review_contract.chain: Terra authors -> one candidate reviewer approves -> Luna executes -> Opus AND Sol independently review the run evidence -> Terra verifies
